psychological_meaning: Lavender purple is often associated with royalty, elegance, and refinement. It combines the stability of blue with the energy of red, softened by a delicate, airy quality. It evokes feelings of nostalgia, sophistication, and grace, while also promoting tranquility and peace.

real_world_examples.title: Luxury Hotel Interiors
real_world_examples.description: High-end hotels often incorporate lavender purple in their interior design to create a sense of opulence and relaxation.
